title: What the instrument caught, and what it missed
note: Something about how the data was collected that changes how to read it. Copy this file to <project>/codebook/notes.csv.

title: Something outside the study that may explain a result
note: Weather, order, fatigue, a room. Name it even when you cannot measure it.

title: A fault in the raw data itself
note: A wrong column, a duplicate submission, an unreliable transcription. Evidence may name a source_id or excerpt_id, or be left blank.

title: Something you looked for and did not find
note: A null result is a result, and it is the one most often lost.
